senses.gloss: f. (רָשָׁה, Hif.) authorization, authority, power of attorney.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 95a:2">Keth. 95ᵃ</cite> <he>נכתבו ה׳ להדדי</he> let the two purchasers of the same property write out a power of attorney to one another (to sue the seller).
<cite ref="Shevuot 31a:13">Shebu. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>הבא בה׳</he> he who comes before court with a power of attorney (not in his own case).
